Hi James — thanks for the clear asks. Drafting a short activation railbook and invoice cadence for you. High-level proposal below and attached a working draft: "activation-railbook.pdf" and a sample invoice schedule spreadsheet.

Proposal (summary):
- Initial annual prepay invoice: issued 2026-06-15, net 30, amount = agreed committed amount (Invoice A).
- Monthly top-ups: optional top-up invoices issued between the 1st–7th of each month; each top-up reduces the available committed balance and is tracked on the ledger.
- Drawdown windows: immediate drawdown against committed balance once funds are received; system-level hold of up to 48 hours for ledger reconciliation and VAT tagging for EU/UK flows.
- VAT handling: Redwood will issue invoices from Redwood Inc. (US) for US entities; for EU/UK we'll issue a mirrored invoice from Redwood EU (VAT-id included) when requested. Sample invoice templates attached.
- Billing contact: Monica Patel (monica_patel@redwood.ai) for ledger alignment and PO matching. Karithik will own the commercial sign-off flow.

Next steps / mutual action plan (short):
1) Redwood sends finalized invoice schedule + activation railbook (this thread) — owner: Rafael — due: 2026-05-26.
2) Acme confirms PO number(s) and legal sign-off, returns DocuSign for scheduled invoices — owner: James — due: 2026-05-28.
3) Finance ops (Monica) and Acme procurement run a quick ledger test with a $10k placeholder payment to validate VAT mapping — owner: Monica/James — due: 2026-06-03.

I've attached: activation-railbook.pdf (detailed steps), draft-invoice-schedule.xlsx (dates/amounts per milestone). Let me know any tweaks and we'll lock it.
